cohort: The study included 75 patients with atopic dermatitis aged 2-10 years and 65 healthy age-compatible volunteers, along with their parents.
finding: Regular emollient use was associated with lower topical corticosteroid requirements and sleep disturbance, while severe atopic dermatitis was linked to birth in winter, advanced maternal age, a history of cesarean delivery, and incubator use.
mod_finding: Severe atopic dermatitis was significantly associated with a history of cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected when the children were aged 2-10 years, retrospectively examining perinatal conditions.
